title: 查找和替换模式
summary: 返回单词列表中能通过字符一一映射变成 pattern 的所有单词。
insight: 一一映射要求双向一致：单词字符到模式字符、模式字符到单词字符都不能冲突；逐位置建立两张映射即可验证。
pitfalls: 映射必须是双射而非单向函数
同一字符重复位置必须保持一致
按输入顺序返回匹配单词

solutions.title: 双向字符映射
solutions.idea: 为每个候选词同步验证两方向对应关系。
steps: 对 word 建立 forward、backward 映射
逐下标读取 a=word[i],b=pattern[i]；已有映射不等则失败
否则写入两方向映射，全部通过则加入答案

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> findAndReplacePattern(String[] words,String pattern){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(String word:words)if(matches(word,pattern))answer.add(word);return answer;}private boolean matches(String word,String pattern){Map<Character,Character> forward=new HashMap<>(),backward=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<word.length();i++){char a=word.charAt(i),b=pattern.charAt(i);if(forward.containsKey(a)&&forward.get(a)!=b||backward.containsKey(b)&&backward.get(b)!=a)return false;forward.put(a,b);backward.put(b,a);}return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findAndReplacePattern(words:Array<String>,pattern:String):List<String> = words.filter{matches(it,pattern)};private fun matches(word:String,pattern:String):Boolean{val forward=mutableMapOf<Char,Char>();val backward=mutableMapOf<Char,Char>();for(i in word.indices){val a=word[i];val b=pattern[i];if(forward.containsKey(a)&&forward[a]!=b||backward.containsKey(b)&&backward[b]!=a)return false;forward[a]=b;backward[b]=a};return true} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool matches(string& word,string& pattern){unordered_map<char,char> forward,backward;for(int i=0;i<(int)word.size();++i){char a=word[i],b=pattern[i];if((forward.count(a)&&forward[a]!=b)||(backward.count(b)&&backward[b]!=a))return false;forward[a]=b;backward[b]=a;}return true;}public:vector<string> findAndReplacePattern(vector<string>& words,string pattern){vector<string> answer;for(string& word:words)if(matches(word,pattern))answer.push_back(word);return answer;} };
